because: Three Coherence and two Mnemion consumed guarantees already have presentation aliases in prototype data. The transplant must demonstrate that project customization, not identity branches in the renderer, reproduces these approved labels while retaining full authored text in inspection.

chose: Preserve project-relative extension declarations in embedded and exported Scope configuration
over: Strip all module names from the browser snapshot
because: Module specifiers are authored configuration data needed for faithful Configure/download round trips. Absolute host resolution stays outside the snapshot, but hiding relative names breaks regeneration and invents no security boundary. Browser code never loads these paths dynamically.

chose: Carry the captured Mnemion hub routing negative control onto the production router and generated Scope page
over: Relying on the historical blockout check to certify transplanted routing
because: The old below-hub detour is a measured failure; exercising the actual shipped router and rendered paths prevents a green prototype from masking a transplant regression.

chose: Bound card text in whole visible lines and add a browser check for fractional-line clipping
over: Accepting rectangle containment as proof that card text is readable
because: The measured Coherence promise card clipped through its last line despite passing outer-box containment. Fixed line slots, no flex shrink, and explicit ellipsis remove that ambiguous presentation; the real-page browser guard inspects internal line geometry as well as card bounds.

chose: Make the all-fields browser probe replace the default view set and assert the fields are rendered
over: Treating Apply preview as evidence that the intended view is selected
because: Screenshot review of all-fields showed the old default tab stayed selected while configuration inheritance added a second Structure tab. The probe must use extends:false and inspect the new view; its earlier passing geometry did not assess optional fields.

chose: Include measured card sizing and row clearance in the registered default browser layout itself
over: Special-casing built-in layout output after the extension interface has returned
because: All-fields cards exposed a collision with fixed guarantee terminals. A project wrapper calling defaults.layout must inherit the same clearance behavior as the shipped view; post-layout identity checks would make that promise false. Custom layouts remain responsible for the geometry they return.
